appearances.title: SenseTime publishes sensenova-roborsi-27b: vision-language model that asks a VLA policy for motion or writes gripper-pose code
appearances.summary: SenseTime's 27B robot-manipulation vision-language model weights are public on Hugging Face. It either requests motion from a vision-language-action policy or writes code for gripper poses. A 9B DFlash2 speculative-decoding draft for SenseNova-Loop was published the same hour.
